title: Llms, Virtual Users, and Bias: Predicting Any Survey Question Without Human Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in the predictive accuracy of LLMs on survey questions by creating virtual user profiles with specific ethnic and geographic backgrounds (e.g., North Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America) and comparing model performance across these groups.

Evaluating disparities in the predictive accuracy of LLMs on survey questions by creating virtual user profiles with specific religious affiliations (e.g., Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Roman Catholicism) and comparing model performance across these groups.
